items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 24:1
items.html:
(to the question) Breasts
The phase of the breasts is a middle phase between the lower and the upper, in which there is a relation to the lower one even at a time when it is not fit to ascend and clothe in the place of the upper one. And there are breasts of an animal, and there are breasts of a person. For at the time of the coupling of AVI to bring out ZA, they must be in the level of AB, and since AVI permanently have only the level of SAG, which is the phase of VAK of AB — because they clothe AA from the throat downward, that is, only the HGT NHY of AA — therefore, at the time of the coupling of kisses of AA, which is drawn from the illumination of the coupling of AB-SAG of AK, a new light is drawn that broke through the Parsa of Atzilut, and the lower two thirds of Atik, which stand in BYA, ascend to the place of the NHY of AA; and the NHY of AA, with the middle two thirds of Atik within them, ascend to the HGT of AA; and the HGT of AA, with the upper two thirds of the NHY of Atik, ascend to the GAR of AA. Then also AVI, who permanently clothe the HGT of AA, ascend also to the GAR of AA, and attain the level of AB like the GAR of AA, as is known. And it is then discerned that the six vessels HGT NHY of AA grew and became ten vessels — HBD HGT NHY — for AVI, in the manner explained in the VAK of ZA at the time of its Gadlut. And it turns out that the upper and middle joints of the HGT of AA became HBD for AVI, and the lower thirds of the HGT of AA, together with the upper thirds of the NHY of AA, became HGT for AVI. And the four thirds of the NHY of AA became NHY for AVI. And this level serves AVI throughout all the months of pregnancy until the time of birth. And here you find two kinds of ascents: first, that the lower two thirds of Atik, whose permanent place is in BYA, ascended now and became the phase of below the Tabur of AA of Atzilut. And the second ascent is that the two upper joints of the NHY of AA were elevated and became the phase of HGT of AVI. And afterward, after the birth of ZA, when AVI returned to their permanent phase, that is, to the level of SAG, nevertheless phases of records from those two upper joints of the NHY of AA remained within their HGT, from the time they were in the level of AB. And likewise records of the lower two thirds of the NHY of Atik remained within the Malchut of AA, even after the birth, when the lower two thirds of Atik had already returned to BYA.
